proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image Generation Pipelines lacking Fallback Orchestration
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines hardcode specific image APIs (Horde, Gemini, Pollinations). When one API rate-limits (429), bans GitHub IPs (403), or degrades in quality, the entire GHA workflow crashes, wasting compute time and producing zero assets.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a unified `UnifiedImageGenerator` Python module with a strict tier-based fallback logic: Tier 1 (Together AI - FLUX-schnell if token available) -> Tier 2 (Cloudflare Workers AI - free 10k neurons) -> Tier 3 (Runware PAYG if funded) -> Tier 4 (Pollinations.ai as absolute fallback). Wrap all calls in exponential backoff retries (using `tenacity` or a lightweight loop) to handle transient 429/503 errors.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of silent pipeline generation failures and maximizes free API tier utilization.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile Bottleneck: Heavy Artifacts Transfer to Android Phone
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone (Termux). Downloading multi-megabyte ZIP artifacts from the GitHub UI on a mobile browser is tedious and slow, hindering rapid publishing to KDP/Redbubble.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a GHA step that automatically uploads optimized final product ZIPs to a free, temp-hosting API (like transfer.sh or pixeldrain) and prints a clean, direct-download URL along with a console-generated QR code (using `python-qrcode` in GHA logs) so Hugo can scan and download files directly to his phone's downloads folder in 1 tap.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 10-15 minutes per publishing cycle; bypasses painful mobile GitHub UI navigation.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Multi-Modal Quality Gatekeeping for AI Artifacts
proposals.current_pain_description: Pollinations or quick FLUX models sometimes output broken anatomy, incomplete borders, or blurry text. Uploading these to Amazon KDP or Redbubble risks account suspensions or 1-star reviews.
proposals.proposed_fix: Leverage the free Gemini 2.5 Flash multi-modal capabilities in `agent_gemini_quality_check` or `agent_visual_audit`. Before saving any generated image to the final artifact, send the image to Gemini with a strict system prompt: 'Analyze this coloring book page/cover. Rate 1-10 on border completion, line clarity, and anatomy. Return JSON.' If score < 7, auto-reject and trigger one regeneration step.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures only high-quality, sellable assets are presented to Hugo, preserving brand reputation on KDP/Redbubble.

proposals.issue_title: Silent GHA Failures due to Missing Mobile Notifications
proposals.current_pain_description: Because Hugo operates on mobile, he has to manually check GitHub Actions runs to see if a pipeline succeeded, failed, or ran out of API credits. This leads to slow response times and idle days.
proposals.proposed_fix: Set up a free Telegram Bot. Write a lightweight bash utility in the GHA workflows that curls a simple message to the Telegram Bot API on success/failure, containing the run URL, generated product count, and any error logs. Hugo gets instant, native notifications on his phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero latency in knowing when assets are ready to publish or when APIs are broken.

proposals.current_pain_description: A vector graphic generated for `produce_svg_pack` or a design for a coloring book is only used once. Hugo is missing out on multiplying his listings with zero extra generation cost.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a 'Cross-Pollination router' step at the end of successful asset generations. For example, if a high-quality SVG is generated for `produce_svg_pack`, automatically pass it to: 1) A wrapper to generate a transparent PNG sticker for Redbubble, 2) An overlay script to create a pattern background for a KDP notebook cover, and 3) A mockup generator for Etsy listing images.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Triples the number of digital products generated per compute-hour and API token spent.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Shared IP Rate-Limiting and Blockades
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runners share public IP ranges that are heavily flag-blocked or rate-limited by cloud providers (like AI Horde 403, and Gemini/Together when scraped without proper headers).
proposals.proposed_fix: Standardize all GHA API requests to include unique, non-generic User-Agent headers (e.g., matching common mobile/desktop browsers) and add random delays (jitter) between sequential API calls to prevent triggering automated cloud firewalls.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces HTTP 403 and 429 blocks from third-party APIs during concurrent pipeline runs.
